posts.product: Sapiver Forge AI Workflow Control Gate
posts.hook: What does a human verification gate actually do?
posts.narration: What does a human verification gate actually do? It pauses an automated workflow at a defined point, presents the evidence and requires a named person to decide whether the workflow may continue. The AI does not approve its own work. See the Sapiver Forge AI Workflow Control Gate.
